sources.note: ComputeSDK measures start time (time to first command) and a clone + install + typecheck job (DAX). Each provider runs at its SDK default size, so DAX machine sizes differ (see env).
boat.dev team fork of StarSling hpc-sandbox-benchmarks; competitor rows from a July CI run. Kept as history only. Not used for rankings or page text.

sources.machine: Requested 4 vCPU / 8 GiB RAM / 40 GB disk on every provider
sources.note: Published by StarSling (upstream repo, not our fork). LEADERBOARD.md on main still shows this run on 2026-11-08; starsling.dev/hpc-sandbox-benchmarks still shows the older run 36498291449 (2026-09-29). StarSling marks the run partial: 800 of 840 cells. Value = median of per-sandbox medians. Rows share a rank when StarSling's test cannot separate them. CPU test = V8 Web Tooling Benchmark (Phoronix node-web-tooling), runs/s, 5 sandboxes x 2 trials. Real repos: 12 sandboxes per provider; repo totals here = sum of per-task medians (StarSling method). Providers ran on different hardware and regions.

computesdk.cold_start_tti.name: Sequential (cold-start) time-to-interactive
computesdk.cold_start_tti.note: 100 sandboxes created one after another; TTI = create call until first command runs. Benchmark retired after 2026-08-07.

computesdk.staggered_tti.name: Staggered TTI
computesdk.staggered_tti.note: 100 creates launched 200 ms apart. Retired after 2026-08-07.

computesdk.burst_tti.name: Burst (concurrent) TTI
computesdk.burst_tti.note: 100 sandboxes created simultaneously; median/p95/p99 per-sandbox TTI; wall_clock_ms = time for all 100 ready.

computesdk.composite_score.name: Composite score
computesdk.composite_score.note: ComputeSDK scoring blends TTI percentiles and success rate; 0 = failed run.

computesdk.dax.name: Sandbox DAX (clone -> install -> typecheck)
computesdk.dax.note: Single iteration per weekly run; phases: prepare (sandbox + tooling), bun download/unpack, git clone, bun install, typecheck. env = hardware the sandbox reported (shapes differ per provider).
